locations.note: Opens atop the Sceptre, a Dubai skyscraper, as 47 and Grey go after the Providence partners.
A gothic manor murder mystery on the Dartmoor moors, where 47 can pose as a detective.
47 is hunted by rival ICA agents inside a sprawling Berlin techno club.
A rain-soaked Chongqing block of noodle shops and neon hides an ICA data facility.
A vineyard harvest party in Argentina's Mendoza wine country sets up the trilogy's reckoning.
The finale aboard a train winding through the Romanian Carpathians.
Ambrose Island, a DLC pirate haven in the Andaman Sea.

routes.name: Agent 47
routes.note: 47 and Grey take down Providence's partners from the top of a Dubai skyscraper to a Dartmoor manor, survive an ICA ambush in Berlin, raid Chongqing and a Mendoza vineyard, and end aboard Arthur Edwards' train through the Carpathians.
